answer: The cornerstone is Soap cutter wick coil seal recorded at the fat store. Lay it as each wick coil is a measured candle yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must cut and the whole wall stands on real work. The nebula tells you who issued it, the ripple tells you what it cost, and the forge tells you when it was earned. A farm that pays for a hundred proofs has already lost the epoch.
